welcome.title: Welcome to Shulius Vintage Server Manager!
welcome.subtitle: Initial cloud features setup
welcome.intro: The app works 100% locally to manage your Vintage Story server. If you also connect it to a PocketBase server, cloud features are enabled:
welcome.feature1: Groups with friends: share worlds and take turns hosting without depending on a single person.
welcome.feature2: Cloud world sync, with versioning and conflict-preventing locks.
welcome.feature3: Version history for every world, with the ability to roll back to an earlier version.
welcome.note: You can skip this now and set it up anytime from Settings → Cloud server.
welcome.configureCloudDesc: Connect to a PocketBase server (your own or your group's).
welcome.localOnlyDesc: Manage local servers without cloud features. You can enable it later.

choose.title: Connect to a PocketBase server
choose.subtitle: This app's cloud is a PocketBase server that you (or someone in your group) controls. There is no mandatory central server.
choose.urlHint: Example: https://pocketbase.my-domain.com — if a friend already set up the group's server, ask them for this URL.
choose.noServerYet: Don't have a server yet? See how to set one up ▾

selfHost.intro: You need a PocketBase instance reachable over the internet (or LAN). Summary of the steps — the full guide with commands is on GitHub:
selfHost.step1: Get somewhere to run it: a cheap VPS (Hetzner, Contabo, Oracle Free...), your own PC, or a home server.
selfHost.step2: Install PocketBase: with Docker/Docker Compose, with a panel like Coolify, or by downloading the official binary (a single executable).
selfHost.step3: Copy the pb_hooks/ and pb_migrations/ folders from the repository next to the server — on startup they automatically create the app's tables and logic.
selfHost.step4: Open the admin panel (/_/) and create your superuser account.
selfHost.step5: Optional but recommended: set up a domain with HTTPS and SMTP for verification emails.
selfHost.time: With Docker or Coolify it takes ~10 minutes. When you're done, come back here and enter the URL.

errors.hooksMissing: Hooks missing: the /api/custom/* routes do not exist on this instance.

hints.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL, for example https://pocketbase.my-domain.com
hints.unreachable: Check that the URL is correct, the server is running, and the port is reachable from this network. If you use HTTPS, the certificate must be valid.
hints.notPocketbase: Check that the URL points to the PocketBase root (without /_/ or extra paths). If you use a reverse proxy, make sure it forwards to the right instance.
hints.schemaMissing: Copy the pb_migrations/ folder from the repository next to the PocketBase executable (or into the Docker volume) and restart the instance: migrations run automatically on startup.
hints.hooksMissing: Copy the pb_hooks/ folder from the repository next to the PocketBase executable (or into the Docker volume) and restart the instance.
